mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, tag_id, summary_id, status, resolution, created_at, resolved_at FROM memory_conflicts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, tag_id, summary_id, status, resolution, ask_text, created_at, resolved_at FROM memory_conflicts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND tag_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.session_id, c.tag_id, c.summary_id, c.status, c.resolution, c.ask_text, c.created_at, c.resolved_at FROM memory_conflicts c JOIN memory_summaries s ON s.id = c.summary_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.status = 'PENDING' AND c.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND s.scope_owner = 'PROJECT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_project_members m WHERE m.project_id = s.project_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN') AND m.deleted = 0) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, tag_id, summary_id, status, resolution, ask_text, created_at, resolved_at FROM memory_conflicts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND tag_id = #{tagId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_conflicts SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolution = #{resolution}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
